name: file-viewer-assets
//: STANDALONE (own lockfile, NOT a workspace member — tools/* is outside pnpm-workspace globs). The file-viewer packages exist only to be COPIED from (runtime IIFE + renderer assets → apps/web/static at prepare time, see apps/web/scripts/copy-file-viewer.mjs). Keeping them out of root resolution matters: their data renderer's sql.js/pg peers forked drizzle-orm into two type-incompatible instances when they lived in apps/web (same failure mode as apps/docs — see pnpm-workspace.yaml).
